log.rules: The game's own line, not the AI's

quick.askHelp: A question in so many words: they answer in their own.

titles.news: Ask what goes on around here.
titles.help: Ask whether they can help you, or what they need.
titles.trade: See what they sell and buy here.
titles.follow: Ask them to travel with you, for a wage.
titles.matter: Ask what they want of you now.

quick.tryHelp: A move with a roll: type what you are after it, your skill and the die decide.

actTitles.persuade: Talk them round: type what they should believe or do after the word.
actTitles.deceive: Make them believe something untrue: type it after the word.
actTitles.intimidate: Press them with a threat. It may cost you their goodwill.
actTitles.bribe: Offer money for what you want: type the sum and what for.
actTitles.insight: Read whether they are telling you the truth.

input.placeholder: Say something to {name}. Enter sends, Shift+Enter for a new line.
input.label: What you say to {name}

about.label: What you know of {name}
about.askAge: How old are you, if I may ask?
